name: afd-call
title: Call a command
description: Invoke any command by name with runtime input validation. Works in all server strategies.

input.description: Command input (validated against the command's own schema at runtime)

confirm.description: Set to true to confirm a command that asks for confirmation, once the user intends it (only on servers that enforce confirmations)

name: afd-batch
title: Run commands in a batch
description: Execute multiple commands in a single batch request with partial success semantics

id.description: Optional client-provided ID for correlating results

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for entire batch

confirm.description: Names of the commands that ask for confirmation and are confirmed, once the user intends them (only on servers that enforce confirmations)

name: afd-pipe
title: Run a command pipeline
description: Execute a pipeline of chained commands where the output of one becomes the input of the next

input.description: Optional pipeline input (any JSON value), available to steps as $input and $input.<path>

Input parameters. A string value that is exactly $prev, $first, $steps[n], $steps.alias or $input, optionally followed by .path (e.g. $prev.items[0].id), is replaced by that data; unresolved references are omitted. Other strings are literals; start one with $$ to send a literal $ (e.g. $$prev).

as.description: Optional alias for referencing this step's output

when.description: Optional condition for running this step (e.g., { $exists: '$prev.id' })

steps.description: Ordered list of pipeline steps to execute

continueOnFailure.description: Continue on failure or stop immediately

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for entire pipeline in milliseconds

confirm.description: Names of the commands that ask for confirmation and are confirmed, once the user intends them (only on servers that enforce confirmations)

name: afd-discover
title: Discover commands
description: List available commands with optional filtering by category, tag, or search text. Returns compact summaries.

tag.description: Filter by tag(s). String for single, array for multiple.

search.description: Text search across names and descriptions

name: afd-detail
title: Describe commands
description: Get the full input schema and metadata for one or more commands by name.

command.description: Command name or names (exact match, kebab-case). String or array of strings (max 10).
